messages:
liz-prod: @channel Heads-up: Private deployment agent v2.1 is rolling to beta next week. Main changes: opt-in telemetry by default for on-prem, configurable audit-log retention, and an install-time consent modal for support access.

omar-se: Is this an automatic upgrade for existing private installs?

liz-prod: No auto-upgrade. Admins will see a prompt to upgrade in Console and via the CLI. We recommend staging the update first; the agent is backward-compatible for 30 days.

claire-legal: Legal notes: updated DPA clauses for telemetry and support access. Air-gapped customers will not have any outbound telemetry unless explicitly enabled in the installer. We'll publish an FAQ for sales and CSMs.

joe-csm: Can we get a short blurb for customers who ask about FedRAMP or export controls?

liz-prod: Blurb: "Private deployments respect data residency and default to opt-out telemetry. For FedRAMP/IL5 conversations, route to Security + Sales for tailored attestations and retention add-ons." I'll add to the CSM kit.

deploy-bot: Beta rollout window: 2026-07-14 03:00-04:00 UTC; config-only, no infra reboot expected.

liz-prod: Quick CLI example to set audit retention:
```bash
redwood private update --deployment eu-prod --audit-retention 365d
```

omar-se: I'll add a CI test to check installer refuses outbound endpoints in air-gapped profiles.

claire-legal: I'll finish the FAQ and send to Joe in 48h.

liz-prod: Action items: Omar -> CI tests; Claire -> FAQ + legal blurb; Joe -> prep CSM kit. DM me to join beta. :thumbsup:
